verdict.rationale: A government tax service could plausibly publish bulk datasets or registry extracts, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a due-dates PDF, downloadable FAQs and manuals, and taxpayer-specific certificates and notices. None of these is a bulk public-data download, registry extract or statistics dataset, and the developer portal entries show only register and login pages.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
